title: Break Narmer/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Kahl: "This where Narmer make Veils for brothers. Kahl say blow it up."
- Daughter: "Better. We can rig these Veils to overload and short out every other Veil in range! Ready?"
- Kahl: "Kahl came out tube ready. Still say blow up better."
- Daughter: "Ugh. Energy barriers. Kahl, find a way to disable them."
- Daughter: "Hm. Kahl, sweetie? See that big magnalocked door up ahead? Could you be a darling and find a way to disable all those locks?"
- Daughter: "Can't figure it out? The security console seems promising."
- Daughter: "Kahl, I'm impressed. How did you figure that out?"
- Daughter: "You're done - time to go through, Kahl."
- Daughter: "Detecting a veiled Solaris worker. Kahl, try your new contraption! 20 credits says it rips his head off."
- Chipper: "YYYYYYYaaaaGHHH what the ALL bloody AS hell ONE you playin' at?!"

- Chipper: "You. With the face like a robber's dog. That thing on your wrist's a muckin' threat, ya weapon. Gimmie ten minutes with it and ya less likely ta deglove someone's head with it! Ah me face."
- Daughter: "The fun part. Find the production controls."

- Daughter: "And here's where the evil's made. Now the tricky part: Kahl, I need you to rekey the boot sequence. Do that and I'll have a split second during reboot to inject my sabotage instructions. Hurry!"
- Daughter: "Look around, do you see anything that could tell you the key sequence?"
- Daughter: "Well done, Kahl. Now to make some noise. They have to think this is a raid. That way they won't suspect tinkering."
- Daughter: "Marking weapons locker. You're gonna need a gun."
- Kahl: "Old gun good. This gun better."
- Kahl: "Kahl always want one of these."
- Daughter: "Kahl! Deacons are hunting you. But your tinkering just got me access to this facility's automatic plasma torch! It'll melt anything, including Deacons. Grab a target marker."
- Daughter: "Great. Now you just show me where to shoot. I'll try not to singe your eyelashes."
- Daughter: "Umm... Kahl? Something... big is coming your way."
- Daughter: "That's it. They don't suspect a thing. They think they've just chased off a smuggler looking for a quick find. Manipulating people isn't fun when it's this easy."
- Daughter: "Nobody around but wrecks and a few Veilheads. Alright. Get in, find the parts Chipper wants, get out."
- Kahl: "This a Thumper station. Thumpers all dead?"
- Daughter: "Hmm? Probably. Sure. Some of your Grineer friends are locked up here. If you want to say hello."
- Daughter: "Propaganda drone. Mother said only the feeble brain fall for that rubish."
- Daughter: "Have you tried pressing buttons at random until something happens."
- Male Ostron: "Never will I submit to Narmer."
- Female Ostron: "The Unum, did she send you? Does she live?"
- Female Ostron: "You will rescue the others, yes?"
- Female Ostron: "Do not succumb to the mask, surah. She gives, we live."
- Female Ostron: "Do not concern yourself with me, surah."
- Female Ostron: "Kruna-metta. My family, I must find them."
- Daughter: "Hmm... don't see any control systems... but there is a shock mine... it might have enough juice to disable the gate. Maybe one of your brothers can arm it?"
- Sprag: "I make shiny bug flat. NOW."
- Daughter: "Kahl. Scope's picking up one of your, uh, 'girl brothers'. I'm not sure what she's carrying, but I would NOT let her hit you with it."
- Daughter: "Kahl... she's completely shielded by her cloaked drones. Those shock mines might reveal them, you'd have to use yourself as bait... but you would not catch me doing that."
- Daughter: "See her drones? Take them out."
- Daughter: "Now's your chance, hit the drones."
- Daughter: "Those shock mines could be useful, get one of your brothers to arm it."
- Daughter: "Command one of your brothers to arm that shock mine."
- Daughter: "Now's your chance Kahl, use your Veilsmasher thingy."
- Sprag: "Huh... Grineer? Maggot! Listen! Find. My. Sister! I give order!"
- Sprag: "Huh... Ven'kra? Ven'kra! No! Where she, maggot? Find now!"
- Sprag: "Ahhh! Trooper! My sister alive! On Murex. Find her."
- Sprag: "Huh... Ven'kra? Ven'kra! No! What they do? Sister. Here?"
- Kahl: "Kahl fight for brothers. Not Queens! But... Kahl break any Veil he find. So. Maybe Kahl find sister one day."
- Daughter: "You want the parts, you better dive for them."
- Daughter: "Kahl. You surprise me. Clever boy."
- Daughter: "Oh, well, by all means let's shop around for something better."
- Daughter: "What about that one? The Thumper. Lots of weapons on that thing."
- Daughter: "I'm sure they're all dead, Kahl. Look at this place."
- Daughter: "Not really. Can we hurry this along?"
- Daughter: "Kahl, looks like there's some bigger firepower for you ahead."
- Kahl: "Old gun good. This gun better."
- Kahl: "Kahl always want one of these."
- Kahl: "Chipper want... lo-co-mo-tor core. That behind armor."
- Daughter: "Just making notes. I am learning so much from you."
- Daughter: "There has to be something we can do. It's just a machine."
- Daughter: "Kahl, there are multiple Ramparts near your location. Heavy gun emplacements. I suggest you use them!"
- Kahl: "Kahl learning soooo much from you."
- Kahl: "Kahl hurt it bad. Now Kahl finish job."
- Daughter: "Okay, I admit, I'm a little impressed. Go on then. Tell me. How did you do that?"
- Kahl: "Shoot in right place. And not die."
- Daughter: "All aboard. Keep your heads and biceps inside the windows."
- Daughter: "Kahl. You almost died here. You don't have to do this."
- Daughter: "Huh... these portals closely resemble the sphincter muscles of a mammal's lower intestinal tract. You're going through this ship like big old..."
- Daughter: "Nope. Sorry. Not at all. You're busy. I'll let you focus."
- Daughter: "There's another group of prisoners on the other end of the Murex. I've identified a dropship you could use to get to them, but... you remember what happened the last time."
- Kahl: "Kahl survived and escaped with his brothers?"
- Daughter: "Something like that. Marking your destination."
- Daughter: "There's the Bolkor. Held in place by Tether Nodes."
- Daughter: "Hmmm... Detecting a sniper rifle in your area, looks like... Grineer special issue. Wonder how that ended up here?"
- Daughter: "Kahl, you've got company. Grineer. She's... not like the others."
- Daughter: "She's shielded by two cloaked drones. I'm targeting a dissipation field to reveal them, but I need your help to triangulate. Order your brothers to take up the marked positions."
- Daughter: "That's it... see the drones? Take aim!"
- Daughter: "Gah...lost the signal... get back in position."
- Daughter: "Can't get a lock. I need you or your squad in position."
- Daughter: "It worked?! Ven'kra's all yours. Sometimes I even surprise myself."
- Daughter: "Now's your chance Kahl, use your Veilsmasher thingy."
- Sprag: "You not worm puppet. You sister, my sister!"
- Sprag: "Remember jungle? Crush shiny bugs? Wake up wake up wake UP!"
- Sprag: "Ven-kra Tel! Ven-kra Tel! We are strongest! We are best! Why you not SING?"
- Sprag: "You save her Kahl. Queens forgive, make you Kuva Lich even!"
- Ven'kra: "Enough. I'm myself again. Kahl... I can make it from here. Should the Queens send us after you... we'll let you know first."
- Ven'kra: "Kahl-175. The legend, in the flesh. And he's just a regular tubeman. If you're waiting for me to thank you, forget it. Sprag and I could be executed just for talking to you."
- Ven'kra: "The humiliation! Tempted by worms. Veiled and now freed by a mere trooper. Oh, little Sprag. Of course this was your doing. I should have known you'd never abandon me."
- Kahl: "Kahl need to stop doing that."
- Daughter: "Get your Brothers, Kahl. I'll arrange your extraction."
- Daughter: "Kahl, Grineer signal ahead, but... abnormal. It's as if he was connected to a Sentient mind before Narmer..."
- Daughter: "Reading massive trauma, amalgam rejection, chemical hypersaturation... *how* is it still *alive?*"
- Kahl: "Brother in pain. Kahl do what Kahl must."
- Daughter: "Kahl, you can't save them all."
- Kahl: "Kahl save. But not from Narmer."
- Daughter: "Kahl. Extraction is ready, get your brothers to the hangar."
- Pazuul: "My father severed the worlds, sundered the link we had forged with Tau, in the days of our enslavement. In the darkness beyond the Veil, we waited. The lords of Tau were silent. "

- Pazuul: "Eat, little ones. Feast. Every cycle, a harvest. Fill your bellies with the sun's rich blood. In Tau, there will be no hunger. Eyes and teeth and tongues, all will be renewed. Devour me..."

- Pazuul: "The Mother and the Father shaped the creatures. The Owl...the Snake...the Wolf...and the Ram, who ruled them all. It was glorious, and the creatures were content. The Ram smiled among new creations' blue blades."

- Pazuul: "I am the flail of judgment. I scour the sinful flesh from the bones, that I may restore you to life. Whole and perfect. Non that are foul, shall set foot upon holy Tau. The docile, and the proud. The fawning, and the mighty. We shall build as one. A pyramid, a flight. Where the knuckle bones, tumble."

- Pazuul: "This is the joyful culmination. Honor and worship upon the prophet Ballas, who fell, that Pazuul might rise. Narmer! I call upon you to build as the termites build. I call upon you to conjoin, as the molecules conjoin. I call upon you to burn as the stars in their orbits burn, and mark the path we shall retread to the world that is to come."

- Pazuul: "I am Pazuul of Narmer. I abjure the Void that scalded my Father's womb. I abjure the Golden Makers. I abjure the Kuva, and the Kuria. I abjure the mannequin and the eyeless. My doctrine shall be a devouring. Let Narmer draw unto herself, all things. Veils to swallow the mind, vessels to swallow the body. A mighty maw to swallow all, and bear us to Tau, as one."
